items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: Sure enough, Benny And I went out to the race track the next day

ctx.x: Well, we went down to the grill to have a sandwich and a glass of beer and there were four or five fellows sitting over in the corner. I had on my blazer with the emblem of the Sports Car Club of America, and they saw that and said, "Hey, you belong to the Sports Car Club of America?" I said, "I certainly do." I pulled out my credentials and showed them. "Come on, have a seat." Well, it turned out, in their minds, Sports Car Club of America -- they have great regard for the Sports Car Club of America. To them…
